preservedHistoricalBoundary.holdReason: HOLD: No authorized automated transfer destination/dedup/readback contract exists for the native Study Log. Preserve actual review evidence and leave Transfer Synced unchanged; source write adapter always refuses.

router.advisoryBoundary: Portable AI advisory report is proposal-only, without synthetic overall Pass/score. validate-report needs real immutable manifest/media byte bindings; local validation alone does not establish a cloud-accessible bundle. It does not satisfy this native scored-route contract or authorize QA, scalar grading, paid approval or mastery. No actual report/bundle supplied.
